sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently topping the First Division South with 34 points from 16 games, travel to New Mills on Saturday 14 November in The Edward Case Cup 2 S. The league leaders are in strong form, having won their most recent fixture and sitting on three wins in their last five league matches, so they will be looking to extend that momentum despite the away fixture against New Mills.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive with Eccleshall in second place (31 points) facing Sandbach's closest challengers. Eccleshall welcome Bilston Town on Saturday, with both sides in excellent recent form—Eccleshall have won four of their last five league matches, while Bilston are unbeaten in their last four. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 31 points and riding a five-match winning streak, travel to New Mills on Wednesday before hosting them again in a rescheduled fixture. AFC Bridgnorth, sitting fourth with 30 points and on a strong run, play two midweek fixtures against Widnes Town (Tuesday) and Shawbury United (Tuesday 17th). Lower down the table, Allscott Heath host Dawley Town on Saturday in a mid-table clash, while Foley Meir face Market Drayton Town and Brereton Social entertain Crewe on the same day. Telford Town visit Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Wednesfield Community face Widnes Town on Saturday. Alsager Town travel to Bilston on Wednesday night in what looks a tough assignment for the bottom-half side. Widnes Town, struggling near the foot of the table, have midweek and Saturday fixtures against top-flight opposition, making their week particularly demanding.
